Definition: from the base of G4556 and ὄνυξ (the nail of a finger; hence the "onyx" stone); a "sardonyx", i.e. the gem so called:-- sardonyx.
BiblicalUsage: The sardonyx is the fifth stone in the foundations of the wall of the New Jerusalem, named in the list of twelve precious stones that carry the city.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the foundations of the city are laid in beauty on purpose: God builds His dwelling place from things of worth.
